sentences.zh: 趙時賞

translations.literal: Zhao Shishang
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shishang

sentences.zh: 趙時賞，字宗白，和州宗室也，居太平州。

translations.literal: Zhao Shishang, styled Zongbai, was a member of the imperial clan from He Prefecture and lived in Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shishang, whose style name was Zongbai, belonged to the imperial clan of He Prefecture and made his home in Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸淳元年擢進士第，累官知宣州旌德縣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianchun he was advanced to the jinshi degree, and rose through successive posts to magistrate of Jingde County in Xuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Xianchun reign he passed the jinshi examination and eventually rose to serve as magistrate of Jingde County in Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年，北軍至境，時賞擁民兵捍戰有功，升直寶章閣、軍器太監。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou, when the northern army reached the border, Shishang led militia in defense and fighting with merit, and was promoted to Direct Associate of the Baozhang Pavilion and Commissioner of Military Equipment.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern armies reached the frontier in the first year of Deyou, Shishang rallied militia to resist them with notable success and was promoted to Direct Associate of the Baozhang Pavilion and Commissioner of Military Equipment.

sentences.zh: 從二王入閩中。

translations.literal: He followed the Two Lords into Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied the two imperial princes into Fujian.

sentences.zh: 益王即位，擢知邵武軍。

translations.literal: When Prince Yi took the throne, Shishang was promoted to administrator of Shaowu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Yi ascended the throne, he was appointed administrator of Shaowu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 未幾，言者以棄城論罷之。

translations.literal: Before long, critics charged him with abandoning the city and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, critics accused him of abandoning his post and he was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 文天祥開都督府於南劍，奏辟參議軍事、江西招討副使。

translations.literal: When Wen Tianxiang opened a military headquarters at Nanjian, he memorialized to appoint Shishang military adviser and Vice Commissioner for Jiangxi Pacification.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen Tianxiang established his headquarters at Nanjian, he recommended Shishang as military adviser and as vice commissioner for the Jiangxi pacification campaign.

sentences.zh: 與宗室孟溁提兵趣贛州，取道石城，復寧都縣。

translations.literal: With the clansman Meng Fen he led troops toward Ganzhou, taking the route through Shicheng and recovering Ningdu County.
translations.idiomatic: Together with the imperial clansman Meng Fen he marched toward Ganzhou, traveling by way of Shicheng and recovering Ningdu County.

sentences.zh: 數以偏師當一面，戰比有勝。

translations.literal: Several times he opposed an entire front with a detached force, and in battle he generally won.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly he held an entire sector with only a detached column, and battle after battle he came away victorious.

sentences.zh: 時賞風神明俊，議論慷慨，有策謀，尤為天祥所知。

translations.literal: Shishang was striking in bearing and quick in mind, bold in speech, skilled in strategy, and was especially valued by Tianxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shishang was handsome and quick-witted, spoke boldly, possessed real strategic talent, and enjoyed Wen Tianxiang's especial trust.

sentences.zh: 及空坑之役，兵敗走吳溪，為追兵所執，不屈死之。

translations.literal: At the battle of Kongkeng his army was defeated; fleeing to Wuxi he was seized by pursuing troops and died refusing to submit.
translations.idiomatic: At the disaster of Kongkeng his force was routed; fleeing to Wuxi he was captured by pursuers and put to death rather than yield.

sentences.zh: 時賞在軍中時，見同列盛輜重，飾姬侍，歎曰：「軍行如春遊，其能濟乎？」

translations.literal: While in the army, seeing his colleagues laden with heavy baggage and adorned with concubines, he sighed and said: "An army moving like a spring outing—how can it succeed?"
translations.idiomatic: In camp he once saw his fellows weighed down with baggage and attended by concubines in full finery. He sighed and said, "If an army marches like a spring pleasure tour, how can it prevail?"

sentences.zh: 及被執，見係累它僚屬至者，時賞輒麾去，云：「小小簽廳官爾，執此何為？」

translations.literal: When captured, seeing other officials bound and brought in, Shishang would wave them away, saying: "Mere petty registry clerks—why seize these?"
translations.idiomatic: After his capture, whenever he saw other bound officials brought in, he would dismiss them, saying, "They are only petty registry clerks—why bother seizing them?"

sentences.zh: 由是得脫者眾。

translations.literal: Because of this many were able to escape.
translations.idiomatic: In this way many of them escaped capture.

sentences.zh: 趙希洎

translations.literal: Zhao Xiji
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiji

sentences.zh: 趙希洎，宗室子，居宜春。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiji, a clansman, lived in Yichun.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiji, a member of the imperial clan, lived at Yichun.

sentences.zh: 歷官至戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He rose through successive posts to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He eventually rose to the post of Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 咸淳中，迕丞相賈似道，出領廣東轉運使。

translations.literal: During Xianchun he offended Chancellor Jia Sidao and was sent out to head the Guangdong transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianchun era he crossed Chancellor Jia Sidao and was posted out as transport commissioner for Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年，制置使黃萬石檄其勤王，得潰卒數百，道經廬陵，郡守邀其軍，遂與從子必向避地贛州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou, Pacification Commissioner Huang Wanshi summoned him to rally to the throne; he gathered several hundred scattered troops; passing Luling the prefect invited his army, so he and his nephew Bixiang withdrew to Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Deyou, Pacification Commissioner Huang Wanshi called on him to march to the emperor's defense. He gathered several hundred scattered soldiers, but when he passed Luling the prefect pressed him to leave his troops behind, so he withdrew with his nephew Bixiang to Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 亂定歸裏，時袁守聶嵩孫，希洎內姻也，勉之內款，不能屈。

translations.literal: When the turmoil settled he returned home. The Yuan prefect Nie Sungsun, Xiji's kinsman by marriage, urged him to surrender inwardly, but could not bend him.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored he returned home. Nie Sungsun, the Yuan prefect, was related to Xiji by marriage and urged him to submit quietly to the new regime, but could not break his resolve.

sentences.zh: 文天祥兵敗，以失言與必向俱被囚，辭節愈厲，家人饋食，則碎器覆諸地，俱不食，據榻而死。

translations.literal: When Wen Tianxiang's army was defeated, for a loose remark he and Bixiang were both imprisoned; their resolve grew fiercer; when family brought food they smashed the vessels and spilled them on the ground; neither ate and both died upon their couch.
translations.idiomatic: After Wen Tianxiang's defeat both men were imprisoned on account of an ill-considered remark. Their defiance only hardened. When their families brought food they smashed the dishes and scattered the food on the ground; neither would eat, and both died where they lay on their couches.

sentences.zh: 劉子薦

translations.literal: Liu Zijian
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zijian

sentences.zh: 劉子薦，字貢伯，吉州安福人。

translations.literal: Liu Zijian, styled Gongbo, was a native of Anfu in Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zijian, whose style name was Gongbo, came from Anfu in Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父夢驥，以進士歷官知澧州，沒於王事。

translations.literal: His father Mengji, a jinshi through successive posts, served as prefect of Li Prefecture and died in the king's service.
translations.idiomatic: His father Mengji, a jinshi graduate who rose through the civil service, served as prefect of Li Prefecture and died in the line of duty.

sentences.zh: 子薦以父任為湘鄉尉，以獲盜功調撫州司錄。

translations.literal: Zijian entered office by his father's privilege as assistant magistrate of Xiangxiang; for merit in capturing bandits he was transferred to recorder of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zijian entered service through his father's privilege as assistant magistrate of Xiangxiang, and for capturing bandits was transferred to the post of recorder of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 有訴王應亨毆死荷擔黃九者，獄成矣，子薦閱爰書，疑而駁之。

translations.literal: There was a suit charging Wang Yingheng with beating to death the porter Huang Jiu; the case was closed, but Zijian reviewed the dossier, suspected error, and rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: In a case charging Wang Yingheng with beating the porter Huang Jiu to death, the verdict had already been finalized, but Zijian examined the file, found grounds for doubt, and rejected the judgment.

sentences.zh: 俄烈風迅雷辟獄戶，裂吏扌契，殺人者實孔目馮汝能，非應亨也。

translations.literal: Suddenly fierce wind and thunder burst open the prison gate and split the clerk's cangue; the killer was in fact the registry clerk Feng Runeng, not Yingheng.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward a violent storm burst open the prison gate and split the shackles of the clerk involved: the real killer was the registry clerk Feng Runeng, not Yingheng.

sentences.zh: 獄遂白，得免死者八人。

translations.literal: The case was then cleared, and eight men who would have been executed were spared.
translations.idiomatic: The case was finally clarified, and eight men who would have been put to death were spared.

sentences.zh: 事聞，頒諭天下之為理官者。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, an edict was issued to all magistrates throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: When word of the affair reached the throne, an edict was promulgated to magistrates throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 改知贛縣，監行在左藏庫，通判常德府，知融州。

translations.literal: He was changed to magistrate of Gan County, supervised the Left Treasury at the traveling court, served as vice-prefect of Changde, and as prefect of Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Gan County, then supervised the Left Treasury at the mobile court, served as vice-prefect of Changde, and finally as prefect of Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，度宗尉之曰：「廣郡凋瘵，賴卿撫摩。」

translations.literal: At his audience on departure, Emperor Duzong comforted him, saying: "The distant prefectures are wasted and afflicted; I rely on you to soothe them."
translations.idiomatic: When he took leave of the throne before departing for his post, Emperor Duzong reassured him, saying, "Those distant prefectures are ravaged and impoverished; I depend on you to restore them."

sentences.zh: 子薦對曰：「臣當推行德化，以安其民。」

translations.literal: Zijian replied: "Your subject will spread virtue and transformation to settle the people."
translations.idiomatic: Zijian answered, "Your servant will spread virtuous governance to bring peace to the people."

sentences.zh: 至官，以廉靜著聞。

translations.literal: On reaching his post he became known for integrity and calm.
translations.idiomatic: Once in office he won renown for integrity and restraint.

sentences.zh: 主管仙都觀，廣西經略司檄為參議官。

translations.literal: He oversaw the Xiandu Abbey; the Guangxi military commission summoned him as advisory officer.
translations.idiomatic: He was placed in charge of Xiandu Abbey, and the Guangxi military commission appointed him as advisory officer.

sentences.zh: 德祐二年十一月，北兵至靜江，權經略使馬塈遣子薦提徭兵藥弩手守城東門，勢不支。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Deyou the northern army reached Jingjiang; Acting Commissioner Ma Que dispatched Zijian with corvée troops and crossbowmen to hold the eastern gate, but the position could not be held.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Deyou the northern armies reached Jingjiang. Acting Commissioner Ma Que sent Zijian with corvée militia and crossbow units to hold the eastern gate, but the defense could not hold.

sentences.zh: 時瀛國公已入燕，子薦取笏書其上云：「我頭可斷，膝不可屈。」

translations.literal: The Lord of Ying had already gone to Yan; Zijian took his tablet and wrote upon it: "My head may be cut off, but my knees will not bend."
translations.idiomatic: By then the young emperor had already been taken to Yan. Zijian took his court tablet and wrote on it, "My head may be cut off, but my knees will not bend."

sentences.zh: 登城北望再拜，取所衣袍瘞之，語左右曰：「事急不可為，吾有以死守。」

translations.literal: He climbed the wall, looked north and bowed twice, took the robe he wore and buried it, and said to those around him: "The crisis admits no further action; I have my means to die holding fast."
translations.idiomatic: He mounted the wall, bowed twice toward the north, buried the robe he was wearing, and told those around him, "There is nothing more to be done in this emergency; I have my own way to die defending my post."

sentences.zh: 或諷子薦遁去，子薦曰：「死事，義也，何以遁為？」

translations.literal: Some urged Zijian to flee; he said: "To die in one's post is righteous duty—why flee?"
translations.idiomatic: Some suggested he flee, but Zijian said, "To die in the performance of duty is what righteousness demands—why should I flee?"

sentences.zh: 竟死之。

translations.literal: In the end he died there.
translations.idiomatic: He died at his post.

sentences.zh: 黃文政

translations.literal: Huang Wenzheng
translations.idiomatic: Huang Wenzheng

sentences.zh: 有黃文政者，淮人。

translations.literal: There was one Huang Wenzheng, a man of the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Huang Wenzheng from the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 戍蜀，軍潰，間道走靜江。

translations.literal: Garrisoned in Shu, when the army collapsed he took a bypath to Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: While garrisoned in Shu, his unit was routed and he made his way by hidden paths to Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 馬塈邀與同守，城破，文政被執，大詬不屈。

translations.literal: Ma Que invited him to join in the defense; when the city fell Wenzheng was seized and reviled them without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Que asked him to join the defense. When the city fell he was captured and poured abuse on his captors without yielding.

sentences.zh: 大軍斷其舌，以次劓刖之，文政含胡叱咄，比死不絕聲。

translations.literal: The army cut out his tongue and in turn mutilated him; Wenzheng still mumbled and shouted abuse, and until death his voice did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: The army cut out his tongue and then mutilated him piece by piece. Huang still mumbled curses and shouts until he died without falling silent.

sentences.zh: 呂文信

translations.literal: Lu Wenxin
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenxin

sentences.zh: 呂文信，文德之弟也。

translations.literal: Lu Wenxin was the younger brother of Wende.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenxin was the younger brother of Lu Wende.

sentences.zh: 仕至武功大夫、沿江副司諮議官。

translations.literal: He served to the rank of Wugong Grandee and Advisory Officer of the Coastal Sub-Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to the rank of Grandee of Military Achievement and served as advisory officer of the coastal sub-commission.

sentences.zh: 德祐初，帥舟師次南康斛林，夾白鹿磯與北兵遇，戰死。

translations.literal: Early in Deyou he led a fleet stationed at Huluin in Nankang, engaged the northern army between Bailu Rock, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Deyou era he commanded a fleet stationed at Huluin in Nankang, met the northern armies near Bailu Rock, and died fighting.

sentences.zh: 特贈寧遠軍承宣使。

translations.literal: He was specially posthumously awarded the rank of Commissioner-in-ordinary of the Ningyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the rank of Commissioner-in-ordinary of the Ningyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 子師憲，特與帶行閣職，與兩子承信郎恩澤。

translations.literal: His son Shixian was specially granted an honorary portfolio post, and both sons received the favor of Chengxin Lang appointments.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shixian was specially granted an honorary portfolio appointment, and both sons were given Chengxin Lang favors.

sentences.zh: 仍立廟賜額。

translations.literal: A shrine was also established and granted an honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: A shrine was also erected and granted an honorific plaque.

sentences.zh: 河湖砦巡檢張興宗亦死之。

translations.literal: Zhang Xingzong, river-and-lake stockade inspector, also died there.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xingzong, inspector of the river and lake stockades, also died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 贈武翼郎，賜緡錢三萬，仍與一子承信郎恩澤。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Wuyi Lang, granted thirty thousand strings of cash, and one son given Chengxin Lang favor.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded the rank of Wuyi Lang, granted thirty thousand strings of cash, and one son was given Chengxin Lang favor.

sentences.zh: 鍾季玉

translations.literal: Zhong Jiyu
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Jiyu

sentences.zh: 鍾季玉，饒州樂平人。

translations.literal: Zhong Jiyu was a native of Leping in Rao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong Jiyu came from Leping in Rao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淳祐七年舉進士，調為都大坑冶屬，改知萬載縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Chunyou he passed the jinshi examination, was assigned as subordinate of the Chief Mining Intendant, and was changed to magistrate of Wanzai County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Chunyou he passed the jinshi examination, was assigned to the chief mining intendant's office, and then appointed magistrate of Wanzai County.

sentences.zh: 淮東制置使李庭芝薦之，遷審計院，改宗正寺簿，又遷樞密院編修，出知建昌軍。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi, Huaidong Pacification Commissioner, recommended him; he was transferred to the Audit Court, changed to registrar of the Clan Temple, then transferred to compiler at the Privy Council, and sent out as administrator of Jianchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi, pacification commissioner for Huaidong, recommended him for advancement through the Audit Court and Clan Temple offices to compiler at the Privy Council, and finally for appointment as administrator of Jianchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 會有旨江西和糴，季玉至郡才半年，屬歲旱，度其經賦不能辦，請於朝，和糴得減三之一。

translations.literal: An edict came for Jiangxi united procurement; Jiyu had been at his post only half a year when drought struck; estimating that tax revenues could not meet the quota he petitioned the court, and united procurement was reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial order required united grain procurement in Jiangxi. Jiyu had been in office only half a year when drought struck. Judging that local revenues could not meet the quota, he petitioned the court and secured a one-third reduction in the procurement levy.

sentences.zh: 遷提舉常平，未幾，改轉運判官，皆不赴。

translations.literal: He was transferred to intendant of the Ever-Normal Granaries; before long changed to transport vice-commissioner, but did not take up either post.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to intendant of the Ever-Normal Granaries and shortly afterward named transport vice-commissioner, but declined both appointments.

sentences.zh: 後以江西轉運判官強起之。

translations.literal: Later he was forcibly recalled as Jiangxi transport vice-commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was compelled to accept appointment as Jiangxi transport vice-commissioner.

sentences.zh: 郡大胥以賄敗，前使百計護之，季玉卒窮治，投嶺表。

translations.literal: A chief clerk of the prefecture fell for bribery; the former commissioner used every means to shield him, but Jiyu in the end prosecuted him thoroughly and had him sent to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: A chief clerical officer of the prefecture was convicted of bribery. The previous commissioner had shielded him by every possible means, but Jiyu finally prosecuted the case to the end and had him sent into exile in Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 俄以秘書丞召還，遭前使構讒而封駁之，改都大提點坑冶。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled as Secretariat Director, but the former commissioner fabricated slander and the appointment was rejected; he was changed to Chief Mining Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon recalled as Secretariat Director, but the former commissioner fabricated charges against him and the appointment was blocked; he was reassigned instead as chief mining intendant.

sentences.zh: 北兵渡江，季玉徙寓建陽，兵至，不屈死之。

translations.literal: When the northern army crossed the Yangzi, Jiyu moved his residence to Jianyang; when troops arrived he refused to submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern armies crossed the Yangzi he withdrew to Jianyang. When enemy troops arrived he refused to submit and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 有潘方者，溫州平陽人。

translations.literal: There was one Pan Fang, a native of Pingyang in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was also a man named Pan Fang from Pingyang in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 寶祐四年進士，調監慶元府市舶。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the fourth year of Baoyou, he was assigned to supervise the maritime trade office of Qingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of Baoyou and was assigned to supervise the maritime trade office of Qingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 慶元降附，方不屈赴水死。

translations.literal: Qingyuan surrendered; Fang would not submit and threw himself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Qingyuan surrendered Fang refused to yield and drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 耿世安，為武翼大夫、淮東副總管、兩淮都撥發官。

translations.literal: Geng Shian served as Wuyi Grandee, Vice Commander-in-chief of Huaidong, and All-Huai Dispatch Officer.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Shian held the rank of Grandee of Military Achievement, served as vice commander-in-chief of Huaidong, and as dispatch officer for the entire Huai region.

sentences.zh: 初，諜報大兵至，制置使賈似道調世安提兵往漣水軍增戍。

translations.literal: At first scouts reported the great army had arrived; Pacification Commissioner Jia Sidao ordered Shian to lead troops to Lianshui Circuit to reinforce the garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When scouts first reported that the main northern army was approaching, Pacification Commissioner Jia Sidao ordered Shian to lead troops to reinforce Lianshui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 眾方猶豫，世安徑迎至漁溝，以三百騎入陳鏖擊，自午至酉，身被七創，猶能追殺潰兵。

translations.literal: While the force still hesitated, Shian went straight to meet them at Yugou, entered the array with three hundred horsemen and fought fiercely from noon to dusk, suffered seven wounds, yet still could pursue and kill routed troops.
translations.idiomatic: While others still hesitated, Shian rode straight to Yugou and charged into the enemy line with three hundred horsemen. He fought from noon until evening, took seven wounds, and still managed to pursue and cut down the fleeing troops.

sentences.zh: 收兵還，至數里沒。

translations.literal: Gathering his troops he returned, but several li from camp he drowned.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew with his troops, but a few li from camp he drowned.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈五官，立廟淮安，賜額忠武。

translations.literal: When reported, he was posthumously awarded five ranks, a shrine was established at Huai'an, and granted the plaque Zhongwu ("Loyal and Martial").
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court he was posthumously advanced five ranks, a shrine was erected at Huai'an, and granted the plaque "Loyal and Martial."

sentences.zh: 丁黼，成都制置使也。

translations.literal: Ding Fu was Chengdu Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Fu served as pacification commissioner of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙三年，北兵自新井入，詐豎宋將李顯忠之旗，直趨成都。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiaxi the northern army entered by Xinjing, falsely raising the banner of the Song general Li Xianzhong, and marched straight on Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiaxi the northern army entered through Xinjing, flying the banner of the Song general Li Xianzhong as a ruse, and advanced straight on Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 黼以為潰卒，以旗榜招之，既審知其非，領兵夜出城南迎戰，至石筍街，兵散，黼力戰死之。

translations.literal: Fu took them for routed troops and summoned them with a placard on a flag; once he knew they were not, he led troops out by night from the south gate to meet them; at Shijun Street the army scattered and Fu fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Fu at first took them for routed Song troops and tried to summon them with a banner placard. Once he saw they were the enemy he led his forces out at night through the south gate to meet them. At Shijun Street his men dispersed and Fu died fighting to the last.

sentences.zh: 方大兵未至，黼先遣妻子南歸，自誓死守。

translations.literal: Before the great army arrived Fu had already sent his wife and children south and vowed to hold the city to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Even before the main army arrived he had sent his wife and children south and sworn to defend Chengdu to the death.

sentences.zh: 至是，從黼者惟幕客楊大異及所信任數人，大異死而復蘇。

translations.literal: At this point only the staff member Yang Dayi and a few trusted men followed Fu; Dayi died and came back to life.
translations.idiomatic: By then only his staff adviser Yang Dayi and a few trusted retainers remained with him; Dayi was struck down but revived.

sentences.zh: 黼帥蜀，為政寬大，蜀人思之。

translations.literal: Fu had governed Shu with lenient rule, and the people of Shu missed him.
translations.idiomatic: As governor of Shu he had ruled with lenient policies, and the people of Shu long remembered him fondly.

sentences.zh: 事平，賜額立廟。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, a shrine was established and granted an honorific plaque.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored a shrine was established and granted an honorific plaque.

sentences.zh: 米立，淮人，三世為將。

translations.literal: Mi Li, a man of the Huai region, three generations soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Mi Li, a native of the Huai region, came from three generations of military men.

sentences.zh: 從陳奕守黃州，奕降，立潰圍出。

translations.literal: Following Chen Yi in the defense of Huang Prefecture, when Yi surrendered Li broke through the encirclement and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Chen Yi in defending Huang Prefecture. When Yi surrendered, Li broke through the encirclement and escaped.

sentences.zh: 江西制置使黃萬石署為帳前都統製。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner Huang Wanshi appointed him Front Headquarters Commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner Huang Wanshi appointed him commander-in-chief of the forward headquarters.

sentences.zh: 大兵略江西，立迎戰於江坊，被執不降，係獄。

translations.literal: The great army overran Jiangxi; Li met them at Jiangfang, was seized and would not submit, and was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army overran Jiangxi he met them in battle at Jiangfang, was captured, refused to submit, and was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 行省遣萬石諭之曰：「吾官階一個先牌寫不盡，今亦降矣。」

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariat sent Wanshi to persuade him, saying: "One honorable plaque of mine cannot even list all my ranks—and now I too have surrendered."
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Secretariat sent Wanshi to persuade him, saying, "Even one honor plaque cannot list all my ranks—and now even I have surrendered."

sentences.zh: 立曰：「侍郎國家大臣，立一小卒爾，何足道。

translations.literal: Li said: "The Vice Commissioner is a great minister of the state; Li is but a petty soldier—what is that to speak of?
translations.idiomatic: Li answered, "You, Vice Commissioner, are a great minister of the state; I am only a petty soldier—what comparison is there?

sentences.zh: 但三世食趙氏祿，趙亡，何以生為？

translations.literal: Yet three generations have eaten the Zhao family's stipend; when Zhao perishes, how can one go on living?
translations.idiomatic: Yet for three generations my family has eaten the Song emperor's stipend. With the Zhao house fallen, how could I go on living?

sentences.zh: 立乃生擒之人，與投拜者不同。」

translations.literal: Li is one taken alive; he is not the same as those who prostrated themselves in surrender."
translations.idiomatic: I was taken alive; I am not like those who came forward and bowed in submission."

sentences.zh: 萬石再三說之，不屈，遂遇害。

translations.literal: Wanshi urged him again and again; he would not yield and was finally executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanshi urged him again and again, but he would not yield and was finally put to death.

sentences.zh: 趙文義者，郢州都統制。

translations.literal: Zhao Wenyi was Commander-in-chief of E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Wenyi served as commander-in-chief of E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 更戍歸，與北兵遇，力戰死之。

translations.literal: Returning from a rotation of garrison duty he met the northern army and died fighting fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from a tour of garrison duty he encountered the northern army and died fighting.

sentences.zh: 初，開州之役，文義兄武義亦死焉。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the campaign at Kai Prefecture, Wenyi's elder brother Wuyi had also died.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the fighting at Kai Prefecture, Wenyi's elder brother Wuyi had also died.

sentences.zh: 有楊壽孫者，為雲安軍主簿兼教參佐忠勝軍。

translations.literal: There was one Yang Shousun, registrar of Yun'an Circuit and instructor assisting the Zhongsheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Yang Shousun who served as registrar of Yun'an Circuit and as instructor-assistant to the Zhongsheng Army.

sentences.zh: 端平中，北兵至中江縣，與將官何庚、安惟臣、田廣澤、歹坤等連戰二日，俱死之。

translations.literal: During Duanping the northern army reached Zhongjiang County; with officers He Geng, An Weichen, Tian Guangze, Dai Kun and others he fought for two days straight and all died.
translations.idiomatic: During the Duanping era the northern army reached Zhongjiang County. With the officers He Geng, An Weichen, Tian Guangze, Dai Kun, and others he fought for two consecutive days and they all died.

sentences.zh: 壽孫贈通直郎，官一子下州文學。

translations.literal: Shousun was posthumously awarded Tongzhi Lang and one son given the post of Lower-Prefecture Literary Fellow.
translations.idiomatic: Shousun was posthumously awarded Tongzhi Lang and one son was granted the post of literary fellow in a subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚等各贈承節，一子進勇副尉。

translations.literal: Geng and the others each received Chengjie and one son Jinyong Vice-Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Geng and the others were each posthumously awarded Chengjie, and one son of each was made Jinyong Vice-Commandant.

sentences.zh: 侯字道子，溫州樂清人。

translations.literal: Hou Fu, styled Daozi, was a native of Yueqing in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Fu, whose style name was Daozi, came from Yueqing in Wen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三貢於鄉，兩試轉運司，皆第一。

translations.literal: Three times presented at the local examinations, twice tested by the transport commission, each time first place.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted himself three times for the local examinations and twice took the transport commission examinations, ranking first every time.

sentences.zh: 以武舉授合浦尉，柳城令，侍衛步軍司幹辦公事，侍衛馬軍行司計議官。

translations.literal: Through the military examination he was appointed assistant magistrate of Hepu, magistrate of Liucheng, staff officer of the Palace Step Army, and planning officer of the Palace Horse Army Executive.
translations.idiomatic: Through the military examination he was appointed assistant magistrate of Hepu and magistrate of Liucheng, then served as staff officer of the Palace Step Army and as planning officer of the Palace Horse Army executive office.

sentences.zh: 寶祐五年，制置使賈似道辟通判海州兼河南府計議官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Baoyou, Pacification Commissioner Jia Sidao appointed him vice-prefect of Haizhou and concurrently planning officer of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Baoyou, Pacification Commissioner Jia Sidao appointed him vice-prefect of Haizhou and concurrently planning officer for Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 李鬆壽據山東，突出漣、泗，鏖城下，死之，懃室遇害。

translations.literal: Li Songshou held Shandong, burst out toward Lian and Si, fought fiercely below the walls, and died; his wife Qin was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Songshou held Shandong he broke out toward Lian and Si, fought fiercely beneath the city walls, and died; his wife Qin was also killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 太學生三十一人言於朝，即海州賜廟旌忠，諡曰節毅，仍立廟其鄉。

translations.literal: Thirty-one students of the Imperial Academy petitioned the court; at once Haizhou was granted a shrine honoring loyalty, posthumous title Jieyi, and a shrine was also established in his home district.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-one Imperial Academy students petitioned the court, which promptly granted Haizhou a shrine honoring loyalty, gave him the posthumous title Jieyi, and ordered a shrine built in his home district as well.

sentences.zh: 所著有《霜崖集》。

translations.literal: His writings include the Collected Works from Frost Cliff.
translations.idiomatic: He was the author of Collected Works from Frost Cliff.

sentences.zh: 王孝忠，為鎮江前軍統製兼淮東路分，戍淮陰。

translations.literal: Wang Xiaozhong served as commander-in-chief of the Jiangqian Vanguard Army and concurrently as Huaidong Circuit sub-commissioner, garrisoned at Huaiyin.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaozhong served as commander-in-chief of the Jiangqian Vanguard Army and as sub-commissioner for Huaidong Circuit, with his garrison at Huaiyin.

sentences.zh: 楊貴叛，孝忠率眾迎戰，勝氣百倍。

translations.literal: When Yang Gui rebelled, Xiaozhong led his troops to meet him in battle, and their morale was a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Gui rebelled, Xiaozhong led his men out to fight and their fighting spirit soared.

sentences.zh: 俄水軍統製朱信降賊，孝忠孤軍力不敵，死焉。

translations.literal: Before long the naval commander Zhu Xin surrendered to the rebels; Xiaozhong, isolated and outmatched, died there.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the naval commander Zhu Xin went over to the rebels. Xiaozhong, left alone and outnumbered, died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 張山翁字君壽，普州人。

translations.literal: Zhang Shanweng, styled Junshou, was a native of Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shanweng, whose style name was Junshou, came from Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 景定三年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the third year of Jingding.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Jingding.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年，為荊湖宣撫司幹官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Deyou he served as staff officer of the Jinghu Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Deyou he served as staff officer of the Jinghu Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 鄂守張晏然議納款，山翁以書譙讓之。

translations.literal: The E Prefecture prefect Zhang Yanran proposed surrender; Shanweng rebuked him in a letter.
translations.idiomatic: When the prefect of E, Zhang Yanran, proposed surrender, Shanweng wrote to rebuke him sharply.

sentences.zh: 晏然既降，山翁被執軍前，諭曰：「 若降，不失作顯官。」

translations.literal: After Yanran had surrendered, Shanweng was seized before the army and admonished, saying: "If you submit, you may still become a prominent official."
translations.idiomatic: After Yanran surrendered, Shanweng was brought before the enemy army and told, "If you submit, you may still receive a high office."

sentences.zh: 山翁酬對不屈。

translations.literal: Shanweng replied without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Shanweng answered without yielding.

sentences.zh: 行省官賈思貞義之，貸不殺。

translations.literal: Jia Sizhen of the Branch Secretariat admired his integrity and spared him from execution.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sizhen, an official of the Branch Secretariat, admired his integrity and spared his life.

sentences.zh: 後居黃鵠山，聚徒教授而終。

translations.literal: Later he lived on Yellow Crane Mountain, gathered disciples to teach, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: He later lived on Yellow Crane Mountain, gathered students to teach, and ended his life there.

sentences.zh: 有《南紀》、《緇林藏》、《雲山》、《相鋤》等集。

translations.literal: He wrote the collections Southern Annals, Black Forest Storehouse, Cloud Mountain, and Mutual Plowing, among others.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Southern Annals, Black Forest Storehouse, Cloud Mountain, Mutual Plowing, and other collections.

sentences.zh: 黃申，字酉鄉，井研人。

translations.literal: Huang Shen, styled Youxiang, was a native of Jingyan.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Shen, whose style name was Youxiang, came from Jingyan.

sentences.zh: 開慶元年進士，授德安尉，攝主簿兼提點江西刑獄司簽廳，獄事多所辨明。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the first year of Kaiqing, he was appointed assistant magistrate of De'an, acted as chief clerk and concurrently registry officer of the Jiangxi Criminal Investigation Commission, and clarified many prison cases.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Kaiqing, was appointed assistant magistrate of De'an, served as acting chief clerk and registry officer of the Jiangxi Criminal Investigation Commission, and cleared up many prison cases.

sentences.zh: 丞相江萬里、提刑黃震交薦之，調樂安丞。

translations.literal: Chancellor Jiang Wanli and investigating commissioner Huang Zhen both recommended him, and he was transferred to assistant magistrate of Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Jiang Wanli and investigating commissioner Huang Zhen both recommended him, and he was transferred to assistant magistrate of Le'an.

sentences.zh: 申為政廉謹，有治聲。

translations.literal: Shen governed with integrity and caution and won a reputation for good administration.
translations.idiomatic: In office Shen governed with integrity and caution and earned a reputation for effective administration.

sentences.zh: 以恩升從事郎。

translations.literal: By favor he was promoted to Associate Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial favor he was promoted to Associate Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 大兵拔撫州，下諸縣索降狀，樂安令率其僚聯署以上。

translations.literal: The great army captured Fuzhou and demanded surrender documents from the counties; the magistrate of Le'an led his subordinates in joint signature to submit them.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army took Fuzhou it demanded surrender documents from the counties, and the magistrate of Le'an had his subordinates sign and submit them jointly.

sentences.zh: 申初聞變，悉遣家人遠避，至是獨抗不往。

translations.literal: When Shen first heard of the crisis he had sent all his family far away to safety; now he alone resisted and would not go.
translations.idiomatic: When Shen first heard of the crisis he had sent his entire family away to safety; now he alone refused to go.

sentences.zh: 令遣吏促之，申不動。

translations.literal: The magistrate sent clerks to urge him, but Shen did not move.
translations.idiomatic: The magistrate sent clerks to summon him, but Shen would not budge.

sentences.zh: 吏白令，令怒。

translations.literal: The clerks reported to the magistrate, and the magistrate grew angry.
translations.idiomatic: The clerks reported back and the magistrate grew furious.

sentences.zh: 俄而吏民數百人集於庭，強輿致之，申顛踣於地，若中風然。

translations.literal: Before long several hundred clerks and commoners gathered in the courtyard and forcibly carried him there; Shen fell to the ground as if stricken by windstroke.
translations.idiomatic: Soon several hundred clerks and townspeople gathered in the courtyard and forcibly carried him off. Shen collapsed to the ground as if stricken by apoplexy.

sentences.zh: 眾捽蹴詬叱曰：「為爾不順，將累我輩。」

translations.literal: The crowd trampled and reviled him, shouting: "Because you will not submit, you will bring disaster on us all."
translations.idiomatic: The crowd kicked and cursed him, shouting, "Because you refuse to submit, you will ruin us all."

sentences.zh: 申陽死為不聞，令無如之何。

translations.literal: Shen feigned death and paid no heed; the magistrate could do nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Shen pretended to be dead and paid no heed, leaving the magistrate helpless.

sentences.zh: 申有惠愛在民，至暮，眾舁入置中堂，翼日或食以粥，得免。

translations.literal: Shen had shown kindness to the people; by evening the crowd carried him in and placed him in the central hall, and the next day some fed him porridge, so he escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: Because Shen had shown kindness to the people, by evening the crowd carried him inside and placed him in the central hall. The next day some fed him porridge, and in this way he escaped harm.

sentences.zh: 遂去，隱巴山中以終。

translations.literal: He then departed and lived in seclusion in the Ba Mountains until his end.
translations.idiomatic: He then left office and lived in seclusion in the Ba Mountains until his death.

sentences.zh: 羍少與謝枋得遊，會枋得起兵安仁，首拔入幕。

translations.literal: Da had been friendly with Xie Fangde from youth; when Fangde raised troops at Anren, Da was the first to join his staff.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Da had known Xie Fangde since youth. When Fangde raised troops at Anren, Da was the first to enter his staff.

sentences.zh: 執安仁令李景，景，羍里人也。

translations.literal: He seized the Anren magistrate Li Jing; Jing was a fellow townsman of Da.
translations.idiomatic: He seized the Anren magistrate Li Jing, who was a fellow townsman of Da.

sentences.zh: 景請得以家貲二萬贖罪，羍曰：「普天之下，莫非王土。

translations.literal: Jing asked to redeem his crime with twenty thousand in family wealth; Da said: "All under Heaven is the king's land.
translations.idiomatic: Jing asked to redeem his offense with twenty thousand in family wealth. Da said, "All under Heaven is the king's land.

sentences.zh: 家財獨非朝廷錢耶？」

translations.literal: Is family wealth alone not the court's money?"
translations.idiomatic: Is private wealth not also the court's money?"

sentences.zh: 聲其罪斬之。

translations.literal: He proclaimed his crime and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed Jing's crimes and had him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 景子率鄉民五千報怨，膠度勢不敵，引兵趨信州。

translations.literal: Jing's son led five thousand villagers to take revenge; Da judged the force could not be matched and led his troops toward Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's son led five thousand villagers to take revenge. Judging that he could not hold his ground, Da led his troops toward Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會守吏遁去，羍聞於朝，就攝郡事。

translations.literal: When the defending officials fled, Da reported to the court and took charge of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the defending officials fled, Da reported to the court and assumed charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 益王即位，羍入覲，遷宗正寺簿、太府寺丞、領江東安撫使。

translations.literal: When Prince Yi took the throne, Da went to audience and was transferred to registrar of the Clan Temple, director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, and put in charge of the Jiangdong Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Yi took the throne, Da went to court and was promoted to registrar of the Clan Temple and director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, and placed in charge of the Jiangdong Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 出上饒，接應郡縣，所部才千餘人，屯火燒山。

translations.literal: He went out from Shangrao to support the prefectures and counties; his command had barely more than a thousand men and camped on Fire-Burning Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He marched out from Shangrao to support the prefectures and counties. His force numbered barely more than a thousand men and encamped on Fire-Burning Mountain.

sentences.zh: 越數月，戰潰，被執至豫章，元帥憐其才，羈縻館留之，遁去。

translations.literal: After several months his army was routed; seized and taken to Yuzhang, the commander pitied his talent and kept him under loose detention in a guesthouse, but he escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later his army was routed. Captured and taken to Yuzhang, the commander pitied his talent and kept him under loose detention in a guesthouse, but he escaped.

sentences.zh: 後三年復起兵，尋敗入積煙山中，自剄死。

translations.literal: Three years later he raised troops again; soon defeated he entered Accumulated-Smoke Mountain and cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later he raised troops again. Soon defeated, he withdrew into Accumulated-Smoke Mountain and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 所著有《鶴心集》，其詩多譏刺當時之士大夫。

translations.literal: His writings include Collected Works of the Crane Heart; his poems often satirize the literati of the day.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Collected Works of the Crane Heart, and his poems often satirize the literati of his day.

sentences.zh: 弟年同時被執，死焉。

translations.literal: His younger brother Nian was seized at the same time and also died.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Nian was captured at the same time and also died.

sentences.zh: 蕭雷龍，字顯辰，建昌新城人。

translations.literal: Xiao Leilong, styled Xianchen, was a native of Xincheng in Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Leilong, whose style name was Xianchen, came from Xincheng in Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 景定三年進士，調臨安府學教授，通判衢州。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the third year of Jingding, he was assigned professor at the Lin'an Prefecture school and vice-prefect of Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the third year of Jingding, was assigned as professor at the Lin'an Prefecture school, and served as vice-prefect of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 及州守棄城遁，朝命雷龍權知府事。

translations.literal: When the prefect abandoned the city and fled, the court ordered Leilong to act as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When the prefect abandoned the city and fled, the court ordered Leilong to act as prefect.

sentences.zh: 北兵薄城下，不降，脫去還建昌。

translations.literal: When the northern army pressed the walls he would not surrender, slipped away, and returned to Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern armies pressed the city walls he refused to surrender, slipped away, and returned to Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 建昌已降，雷龍與同里人黃巡檢起兵。

translations.literal: Jianchang had already surrendered; Leilong and a fellow townsman, Inspector Huang, raised troops.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang had already surrendered, but Leilong and a fellow townsman, Inspector Huang, raised troops.

sentences.zh: 時大兵四合，雷龍度不可支，與黃巡檢及麾下數人奔入閩，未出境，為同安武人徐浚衝獲送縣。

translations.literal: At that time the great army closed in from all sides; Leilong judged it could not be sustained and, with Inspector Huang and a few followers under his command, fled into Fujian; before crossing the border he was seized by Xu Jun, a militiaman of Tong'an, and sent to the county.
translations.idiomatic: The main army then closed in from all sides. Leilong judged that resistance could not be sustained and, with Inspector Huang and a few followers, fled into Fujian. Before he crossed the border he was seized by Xu Jun, a militiaman of Tong'an, and sent to the county seat.

sentences.zh: 權縣尹劉聖仲素與雷龍有怨，殺之。

translations.literal: The acting county magistrate Liu Shengzhong had long borne a grudge against Leilong and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: The acting county magistrate Liu Shengzhong had long borne a grudge against Leilong and had him killed.

sentences.zh: 後聖仲北來，泊舟小孤山，有巨艦衝前，建大旗書曰「蕭知府兵」，繼見雷龍坐船上，聖仲大呼，有頃不見，以驚死。

translations.literal: Later Shengzhong came north; mooring his boat at Little Solitary Mountain, a great ship charged ahead flying a banner reading "Forces of Prefect Xiao"; then he saw Leilong seated on the ship. Shengzhong cried out loudly; in a moment both vanished, and he died of fright.
translations.idiomatic: Later Shengzhong traveled north. When he moored at Little Solitary Mountain, a great ship charged ahead bearing a banner that read "Forces of Prefect Xiao," and then he saw Leilong seated aboard. Shengzhong cried out in alarm; in a moment both vanished, and he died of fright.

sentences.zh: 宋應龍者，儒生。

translations.literal: Song Yinglong was a Confucian scholar.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yinglong was a Confucian scholar.

sentences.zh: 通兵，出入行陳三十餘年，為諮議官，寓泰州。

translations.literal: Skilled in military affairs, for more than thirty years he went in and out of the battle lines as an advisory officer and resided at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled in military affairs, for more than thirty years he moved in and out of the battle lines as an advisory officer and lived at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 德祐二年六月甲寅，大兵至泰州，裨校孫貴、胡惟孝、尹端甫、李遇春開門迎降，應龍與其妻自縊於圃中。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the sixth month of the second year of Deyou the great army reached Taizhou; deputy commanders Sun Gui, Hu Weixiao, Yin Duanfu, and Li Yuchun opened the gates to welcome surrender; Yinglong and his wife hanged themselves in the garden.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the sixth month of the second year of Deyou the main army reached Taizhou. Deputy commanders Sun Gui, Hu Weixiao, Yin Duanfu, and Li Yuchun opened the gates in welcome. Yinglong and his wife hanged themselves in the garden.

sentences.zh: 是時，提刑諮議褚一正字粹翁，廬州人，武舉進士。

translations.literal: At that time the criminal investigation advisory officer Chu Yizheng, styled Cuion, a native of Luzhou, was a military examination graduate.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the criminal investigation advisory officer Chu Yizheng, whose style name was Cuion, a native of Luzhou, was a military examination graduate.

sentences.zh: 督戰高沙被創，竟沒於水。

translations.literal: Directing the fighting at Gaosha he was wounded and finally perished in the water.
translations.idiomatic: While directing the fighting at Gaosha he was wounded and finally drowned.

sentences.zh: 知興化縣胡拱辰，縣破，亦死之。

translations.literal: The magistrate of Xinghua, Hu Gongchen, when the county fell also died.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Gongchen, magistrate of Xinghua, also died when the county fell.

sentences.zh: 鄒洬，字鳳叔，吉水人，後徙永豐。

translations.literal: Zou Feng, styled Fengshu, was a native of Jishui and later moved to Yongfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zou Feng, whose style name was Fengshu, came from Jishui and later moved to Yongfeng.

sentences.zh: 少慷慨有大志，以豪俠鳴。

translations.literal: From youth he was bold and ambitious, famed for heroic spirit.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was bold and ambitious and won fame for his heroic spirit.

sentences.zh: 從文天祥勤王，補武資至將軍。

translations.literal: Following Wen Tianxiang in rallying to the throne, he was given military standing up to general.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Wen Tianxiang in rallying to the throne and was given military standing up to the rank of general.

sentences.zh: 益王立，改寺丞，領江西招諭副使。

translations.literal: When Prince Yi was established, he was changed to temple director and put in charge as vice commissioner for Jiangxi pacification.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Yi was established he was made temple director and appointed vice commissioner for Jiangxi pacification.

sentences.zh: 聚兵寧都，得數萬，改授江西安撫副使。

translations.literal: He gathered troops at Ningdu and obtained several tens of thousands; he was then appointed Jiangxi Pacification Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He gathered troops at Ningdu and raised several tens of thousands of men, then was appointed Jiangxi Pacification Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 復興國、永豐二縣，進兵部侍郎兼江東、西處置副使。

translations.literal: He recovered Xingguo and Yongfeng counties and was advanced to Vice Minister of War and concurrently vice commissioner for Jiangdong and Jiangxi disposition.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Xingguo and Yongfeng counties and was promoted to Vice Minister of War and concurrently vice commissioner for disposition in Jiangdong and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 及永豐敗，繼從天祥間關嶺道，未幾，復出開督府，分司永豐、興國境上。

translations.literal: When Yongfeng fell he again followed Tianxiang along the difficult Ling route; before long he came out again to open the headquarters and served as deputy for the Yongfeng and Xingguo border.
translations.idiomatic: When Yongfeng fell he again followed Tianxiang along the difficult mountain route into Lingnan. Before long he came out again to reopen the headquarters and served on the Yongfeng and Xingguo border.

sentences.zh: 北兵驟至，大戰，洬脫身走至潮州。

translations.literal: The northern army arrived suddenly; in the great battle Feng broke free and fled to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: The northern army arrived suddenly. In the great battle Feng broke free and fled to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 及天祥被執，洬自殺。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang was captured, Feng killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang was captured, Feng took his own life.

sentences.zh: 當是時，從天祥勤王死事者，洬與劉子俊等凡十有九人，因次第其名，附見左方。

translations.literal: At that time those who followed Tianxiang in rallying to the throne and died in his service, including Feng and Liu Zijun, numbered nineteen in all; their names are therefore set forth in order and appended at left.
translations.idiomatic: At that time nineteen men in all, including Feng and Liu Zijun, followed Tianxiang in rallying to the throne and died in his service; their names are therefore listed in order and appended below.

sentences.zh: 劉子俊字民章，廬陵人。

translations.literal: Liu Zijun, styled Minzhang, was a native of Luling.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zijun, whose style name was Minzhang, came from Luling.

sentences.zh: 嘗中漕試。

translations.literal: He once placed first in the transport commission examination.
translations.idiomatic: He had once ranked first in the transport commission examination.

sentences.zh: 少與文天祥同里閈，相友善。

translations.literal: From youth he lived in the same neighborhood as Wen Tianxiang and they were close friends.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he lived in the same neighborhood as Wen Tianxiang and they were close friends.

sentences.zh: 天祥開督府興國，子俊詣府計事，補宣教郎、帶行軍器監簿兼督府機宜。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Xingguo, Zijun came to the headquarters to discuss affairs and was appointed Instructor, honorary Military Equipment Commissioner, and concurrently headquarters planner.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Xingguo, Zijun came to discuss affairs and was appointed Instructor, honorary Military Equipment Commissioner, and concurrently headquarters planner.

sentences.zh: 空坑兵敗，子俊收兵保洞源，接應郡縣。

translations.literal: At the defeat of Kongkeng he gathered troops to hold Dongyuan and supported the prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: After the defeat at Kongkeng he gathered troops to hold Dongyuan and supported the prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 尋入廣，與大兵遇，戰潰，復招集散亡，與鄒洬同趨潮州。

translations.literal: Soon he entered Guang, met the great army, was routed, again gathered the scattered remnants, and with Zou Feng hurried to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered Guang, met the main army, was routed, gathered the scattered remnants again, and with Zou Feng hurried to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 天祥兵敗，子俊被執，自詭為天祥，意使大兵不窮追，天祥可間走也。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang's army was defeated, Zijun was seized and falsely claimed to be Tianxiang, intending that the great army not pursue relentlessly so Tianxiang might escape by a hidden route.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang's army was defeated, Zijun was captured and falsely claimed to be Tianxiang, hoping the enemy would not pursue relentlessly so Tianxiang might escape by another route.

sentences.zh: 未幾，別隊執天祥至，相遇於途，各爭真贗，至大將前，始得其實，乃烹子俊。

translations.literal: Before long another detachment seized Tianxiang and brought him; they met on the road and each disputed which was genuine; before the great commander the truth was known, and Zijun was boiled alive.
translations.idiomatic: Before long another detachment captured Tianxiang and brought him along. They met on the road and each disputed which was genuine. Before the commander the truth was known, and Zijun was boiled alive.

sentences.zh: 劉沐字淵伯，廬陵人。

translations.literal: Liu Mu, styled Yuanbo, was a native of Luling.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mu, whose style name was Yuanbo, came from Luling.

sentences.zh: 文天祥鄰曲也，少相狎昵，天祥好奕，與沐對奕，窮思忘日夜以為常。

translations.literal: He was Tianxiang's neighbor; from youth they were intimate; Tianxiang loved weiqi and played against Mu, exhausting thought day and night as their constant habit.
translations.idiomatic: He was Tianxiang's neighbor. From youth they were intimate companions. Tianxiang loved weiqi and played against Mu, thinking through the game day and night as their constant habit.

sentences.zh: 及起兵，辟補宣教郎、督府機宜。

translations.literal: When troops were raised he was appointed Instructor and headquarters planner.
translations.idiomatic: When troops were raised he was appointed Instructor and headquarters planner.

sentences.zh: 暨天祥出使，沐領兵還。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang went on embassy, Mu led the troops back.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang went on embassy, Mu led the troops back.

sentences.zh: 天祥歸，開府南劍，沐收部曲來會，改授太府寺簿，專將一軍，為督府親衛。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang returned and opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Mu gathered his command and came to join him; he was changed to director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, commanded a separate army, and became the headquarters personal guard.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang returned and opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Mu gathered his command and came to join him. He was then made director of the Court of the Imperial Clan, given command of a separate army, and made the headquarters personal guard.

sentences.zh: 會空坑兵敗，被執至豫章，父子同日死焉。

translations.literal: At the defeat of Kongkeng he was seized and taken to Yuzhang; father and son died on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: At the defeat of Kongkeng he was captured and taken to Yuzhang, where father and son died on the same day.

sentences.zh: 仲子死亂兵，季子復從天祥死嶺南。

translations.literal: The second son died in the chaos of battle; the youngest son again followed Tianxiang and died in Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: His second son died in the chaos of battle; his youngest son again followed Tianxiang and died in Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 當時江西忠義皆沐所號召。

translations.literal: At that time the loyal and righteous of Jiangxi were all summoned by Mu.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the loyal and righteous men of Jiangxi were all summoned into service by Mu.

sentences.zh: 沐性沈實而圜機，晝夜應酬，亹不倦云。

translations.literal: Mu's nature was deep and solid yet resourceful; day and night he answered calls without weariness.
translations.idiomatic: Mu was deep and steady yet resourceful, answering demands day and night without weariness.

sentences.zh: 孫㮚字實甫，吉州龍泉人，獻簡公抃之後，天祥長妹婿也。

translations.literal: Sun Li, styled Shifu, was a native of Longquan in Ji Prefecture, a descendant of the Presented Duke Bian, and husband to Tianxiang's elder sister's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Li, whose style name was Shifu, came from Longquan in Ji Prefecture. He was a descendant of the Presented Duke Bian and was married to the daughter of Tianxiang's elder sister.

sentences.zh: 天祥起兵，檄㮚招忠義士，補宣教郎、帶行監官告院、知吉州龍泉縣。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang raised troops he issued a summons to Li to recruit loyal and righteous men; Li was appointed Instructor, honorary Director of the Court of Imperial Patent, and magistrate of Longquan in Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang raised troops he summoned Li to recruit loyal and righteous men. Li was appointed Instructor, honorary Director of the Court of Imperial Patent, and magistrate of Longquan in Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天祥擁兵出贛，里人奉㮚復龍泉，拒守不下，尋為叛者所陷，執至隆興殺之。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang led his army out of Gan, the villagers supported Li in recovering Longquan and held it without yielding; soon he was trapped by rebels, seized, and killed at Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang led his army out of Gan, the villagers supported Li in recovering Longquan and held it without yielding. Soon he was trapped by rebels, captured, and killed at Longxing.

sentences.zh: 彭震龍字雷可，永新人，天祥次妹婿也。

translations.literal: Peng Zhenlong, styled Leike, was a native of Yongxin and husband to Tianxiang's younger sister's daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Zhenlong, whose style name was Leike, came from Yongxin and was married to the daughter of Tianxiang's younger sister.

sentences.zh: 性跌蕩喜事，嘗以罪墨。

translations.literal: His nature was unrestrained and fond of stirring events; he had once been tattooed for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: He was unrestrained by nature and fond of stirring events; he had once been tattooed as punishment for a crime.

sentences.zh: 天祥起兵，補宣教郎、帶行太社令、知永新縣。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang raised troops he was appointed Instructor, honorary Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and magistrate of Yongxin.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang raised troops he was appointed Instructor, honorary Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and magistrate of Yongxin.

sentences.zh: 會天祥出使被執，震龍遁歸，吉州已失，乃結峒獠起兵。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang went on embassy and was seized, Zhenlong slipped back; Ji Prefecture was already lost, so he rallied the cave tribes to raise troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang went on embassy and was captured, Zhenlong slipped back home. Ji Prefecture was already lost, so he rallied the cave tribes to raise troops.

sentences.zh: 天祥兵出嶺，震龍接應，復永新。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang's army came out of the Ling passes, Zhenlong supported him and recovered Yongxin.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang's army came out of the Ling passes, Zhenlong supported him and recovered Yongxin.

sentences.zh: 大兵至，震龍為親黨所執，至帥府，腰斬之，屠永新。

translations.literal: When the great army arrived, Zhenlong was seized by his own kin, taken to the commander's headquarters, cut in two at the waist, and Yongxin was put to the sword.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army arrived, Zhenlong was seized by his own kin, taken to the commander's headquarters, cut in two at the waist, and Yongxin was put to the sword.

sentences.zh: 蕭燾夫，永新人，與兄敬夫俱天祥客。

translations.literal: Xiao Daofu of Yongxin, together with his elder brother Jingfu, were both Tianxiang's clients.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Daofu of Yongxin, together with his elder brother Jingfu, were both clients of Tianxiang.

sentences.zh: 燾夫為詩有豪俊氣。

translations.literal: Daofu's poetry had a bold and heroic air.
translations.idiomatic: Daofu's poetry had a bold and heroic spirit.

sentences.zh: 天祥起兵，補從仕郎。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang raised troops he was appointed Associate Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang raised troops he was appointed Associate Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 及彭震龍謀復其縣，燾夫讚之。

translations.literal: When Peng Zhenlong planned to recover the county, Daofu supported him.
translations.idiomatic: When Peng Zhenlong planned to recover the county, Daofu supported him.

sentences.zh: 縣受屠，兄弟俱死之。

translations.literal: When the county was put to the sword, the brothers both died.
translations.idiomatic: When the county was put to the sword, both brothers died.

sentences.zh: 陳繼周字碩卿，寧都人。

translations.literal: Chen Jizhou, styled Shuoqing, was a native of Ningdu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jizhou, whose style name was Shuoqing, came from Ningdu.

sentences.zh: 淳祐三年貢於鄉。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunyou he was presented at the local examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunyou he was presented at the local examinations.

sentences.zh: 以捕盜功行，未奏名，授廉州司法，南豐縣知錄，淮東總領幹官，藤州觀察推官，知吉州永豐縣，改知高安縣、廣東經略司準備差遣、知衡陽縣，辟淮東轉般倉、江東提點刑獄幹辦公事。

translations.literal: For merit in capturing bandits he was advanced, though his name had not yet been submitted; he was appointed judicial officer of Lian Prefecture, recorder of Nanfeng County, staff officer of the Huaidong Chief Intendant, observation push officer of Teng Prefecture, magistrate of Yongfeng in Ji Prefecture, changed to magistrate of Gao'an, prepared agent of the Guangdong Military Commission, magistrate of Hengyang County, summoned to the Huaidong transport granary, and staff officer of the Jiangdong Criminal Investigation Commission.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in capturing bandits he was advanced before his name had been formally submitted. He was appointed judicial officer of Lian Prefecture, recorder of Nanfeng County, staff officer of the Huaidong Chief Intendant, observation push officer of Teng Prefecture, magistrate of Yongfeng in Ji Prefecture, then magistrate of Gao'an, prepared agent of the Guangdong Military Commission, magistrate of Hengyang County, and summoned to the Huaidong transport granary and the Jiangdong Criminal Investigation Commission.

sentences.zh: 未上，會咸淳十年，詔征勤王，文天祥方守贛州，即日舉兵，造繼周問計。

translations.literal: Before he took up his post, in the tenth year of Xianchun an edict summoned troops to rally to the throne; Wen Tianxiang was then defending Ganzhou and that very day raised troops and came to Jizhou to ask his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Before he took up his post, in the tenth year of Xianchun an edict summoned troops to rally to the throne. Wen Tianxiang was then defending Ganzhou, raised troops that very day, and came to Jizhou to ask his counsel.

sentences.zh: 繼周慨然為具言閭里豪傑子弟與凡起兵之處，其為方略甚詳。

translations.literal: Jizhou spoke with feeling and set forth in detail the heroic youths of the villages and every place where troops might be raised, with his plans very thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou spoke earnestly and laid out in detail the local heroes and every place where troops could be raised, with his plans worked out very thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 於是留繼周幕中，晝夜調度，授繼周江西安撫司準備差遣，率贛士以從。

translations.literal: He therefore kept Jizhou in his staff, scheduling day and night, appointed him prepared agent of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, and led Gan men to follow.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore kept Jizhou on his staff, directing affairs day and night, appointed him prepared agent of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, and led men from Gan to follow him.

sentences.zh: 繼周雖弱不勝衣，而年德有以服人，士視為父兄，進止疾徐惟指呼，無敢先後。

translations.literal: Though Jizhou was so frail he could scarcely bear his clothes, his years and virtue won men's submission; the soldiers regarded him as a father or elder brother, advancing or halting only at his command, none daring to go before or after.
translations.idiomatic: Though Jizhou was so frail he seemed barely able to bear his clothes, his age and virtue won men's respect. The soldiers treated him as a father or elder brother, moving only at his command, none daring to step out of order.

sentences.zh: 詔改繼周合入官，帶行監文思院，差充江、浙制置司主管機宜。

translations.literal: An edict changed Jizhou's status to regular office, honorary Director of the Wensi Court, and detailed him as chief planner of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: An edict regularized Jizhou's appointment, granted him honorary Director of the Wensi Court, and detailed him as chief planner of the Jiangsu-Zhejiang Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 所部夜襲大兵於南柵門，殺傷相當，質明猶戰，渴赴水死。

translations.literal: His command made a night assault on the great army at the southern stockade gate; casualties were about equal; at dawn they still fought; parched, he rushed into the water and drowned.
translations.idiomatic: His command made a night assault on the enemy at the southern stockade gate. Casualties were roughly equal, and fighting continued at dawn. Thirsty, he rushed into the water and drowned.

sentences.zh: 張汴字朝宗，一字次山，蜀人。

translations.literal: Zhang Bian, styled Chaozong, also styled Cishan, was a man of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bian, whose style names were Chaozong and Cishan, came from Shu.

sentences.zh: 少客丞相吳潛兄弟門，出入荊閫曆年，明習韜略。

translations.literal: From youth he was a client in the household of Chancellor Wu Qian and his brothers; for years he went in and out of the Jinghu commandery and was well versed in strategy.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had been a client in the household of Chancellor Wu Qian and his brothers. For years he moved in and out of the Jinghu commandery and became thoroughly versed in strategy.

sentences.zh: 潛兄弟既罷，廢斥者十餘年。

translations.literal: After the Wu brothers were dismissed, he was cast aside for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: After the Wu brothers were dismissed, he was cast aside for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 繼文天祥起兵，辟為秘閣修撰，領廣東提舉、督府參謀，左右幕府，知無不為。

translations.literal: When Wen Tianxiang raised troops he was summoned as Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion, put in charge of Guangdong intendant and headquarters strategist, serving in the left and right staffs of the headquarters, doing whatever he knew to do.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen Tianxiang raised troops he was summoned as Compiler of the Secretariat Pavilion, placed in charge of the Guangdong intendant's office and as headquarters strategist, serving in the headquarters staff and doing whatever he could.

sentences.zh: 空坑兵敗，為亂兵所殺。

translations.literal: At the defeat of Kongkeng he was killed by mutinous troops.
translations.idiomatic: At the defeat of Kongkeng he was killed by mutinous troops.

sentences.zh: 處置使鄒洬得其屍葬之。

translations.literal: Disposition Commissioner Zou Feng obtained his body and buried it.
translations.idiomatic: Disposition Commissioner Zou Feng recovered his body and buried it.

sentences.zh: 呂武，太平州步卒也。

translations.literal: Lu Wu was a foot soldier of Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wu was a foot soldier of Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 文天祥出使，武應募從行，偕脫鎮江之難，沿淮東走海道，賴武力為多。

translations.literal: When Wen Tianxiang went on embassy, Wu volunteered to follow; together they escaped the peril at Zhenjiang and fled along the Huai coast by sea route, relying greatly on his martial strength.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen Tianxiang went on embassy, Wu volunteered to accompany him. Together they escaped the danger at Zhenjiang and fled along the Huai coast by sea, relying greatly on his martial strength.

sentences.zh: 天祥開府南劍，武以武功補官，遣之結約州縣起兵相應。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Wu was given office through military merit and was sent to arrange alliances with prefectures and counties to raise troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Wu was given office through military merit and was sent to arrange alliances with prefectures and counties to raise troops in response.

sentences.zh: 道阻，復崎嶇數千里即天祥於汀、梅，挺身患難，化賊為兵。

translations.literal: The road was blocked; again he traveled thousands of li over rugged terrain to reach Tianxiang at Ting and Mei, throwing himself into hardship, turning bandits into soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: When the road was blocked he again traveled thousands of li over rugged terrain to reach Tianxiang in Ting and Mei, throwing himself into hardship and turning bandits into soldiers.

sentences.zh: 以環衛官將數千人出江西，以遇士大夫無禮，死於橫逆，一軍揮涕而葬之。

translations.literal: Leading several thousand men as a palace guard general into Jiangxi, because he was rude to scholars and officials he died by violence; the whole army wept as they buried him.
translations.idiomatic: Leading several thousand men as a palace guard general into Jiangxi, he died by violence because he was rude to scholars and officials. The whole army wept as they buried him.

sentences.zh: 武忠梗出天性，不避強禦，而好面折人過，多觸忌諱，故及於禍云。

translations.literal: Wu's loyalty and bluntness came from his nature; he did not avoid the powerful, yet he liked to rebuke others' faults to their faces and often gave offense, and therefore met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Wu's loyalty and bluntness came from his nature. He did not avoid the powerful, yet he liked to rebuke others' faults to their faces and often gave offense, and therefore met disaster.

sentences.zh: 鞏信，安豐軍人。

translations.literal: Gong Xin was a native of Anfeng Army.
translations.idiomatic: Gong Xin came from Anfeng Army.

sentences.zh: 為荊湖都統，沈勇有謀。

translations.literal: He was overall commander of Jinghu, deep and brave with strategy.
translations.idiomatic: He served as overall commander of Jinghu and was deep, brave, and resourceful.

sentences.zh: 本隸蘇劉義部曲，文天祥開督府，劉義以信與王福、張必勝詣天祥。

translations.literal: Originally he belonged to Su Liuyi's command; when Tianxiang opened his headquarters, Liuyi sent Xin with Wang Fu and Zhang Bisheng to Tianxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Originally he belonged to Su Liuyi's command. When Tianxiang opened his headquarters, Liuyi sent Xin with Wang Fu and Zhang Bisheng to join him.

sentences.zh: 信官至團練使、同督府都統製、江西招討使。

translations.literal: Xin rose to regimental trainer, concurrent headquarters commander-in-chief, and Jiangxi pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xin rose to regimental trainer, concurrent headquarters commander-in-chief, and Jiangxi pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 初至都府，天祥以義士千人付之，信曰：「此輩徒累人爾。」

translations.literal: When he first arrived at the headquarters, Tianxiang entrusted him with a thousand righteous volunteers; Xin said: "These men only burden others."
translations.idiomatic: When he first arrived at headquarters, Tianxiang entrusted him with a thousand volunteer fighters. Xin said, "These men only burden others."

sentences.zh: 乃招淮士數千自隨，然常怏怏曰：「有將無兵，其如彼何！」

translations.literal: He then recruited several thousand Huai men to follow him, yet often said discontentedly: "To have generals without soldiers—what can be done against them!"
translations.idiomatic: He then recruited several thousand Huai men to follow him, yet often said in discontent, "To have generals without soldiers—what can be done against them!"

sentences.zh: 天祥自興國趨永豐，大兵追其後，信戰於方石嶺，中數矢，傷重不能戰，自投崖石而死。

translations.literal: Tianxiang hurried from Xingguo toward Yongfeng; the great army pursued behind; Xin fought at Fangshi Ridge, was struck by several arrows, was too gravely wounded to fight, and threw himself from the cliff to his death.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang hurried from Xingguo toward Yongfeng with the main army in pursuit. Xin fought at Fangshi Ridge, was struck by several arrows, was too gravely wounded to continue fighting, and threw himself from the cliff to his death.

sentences.zh: 士人葬之，顏色如生。

translations.literal: Scholars buried him; his complexion was as in life.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars buried him, and his complexion looked as it had in life.

sentences.zh: 贈清遠軍承宣使，立廟旌之。

translations.literal: He was posthumously awarded Commissioner-in-ordinary of the Qingyuan Army and a shrine was established to honor him.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded Commissioner-in-ordinary of the Qingyuan Army, and a shrine was established to honor him.

sentences.zh: 蕭明哲字元甫，太和人。

translations.literal: Xiao Mingzhe, styled Yuanfu, was a native of Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Mingzhe, whose style name was Yuanfu, came from Taihe.

sentences.zh: 性剛毅有膽氣，明大節。

translations.literal: His nature was firm and resolute with courage, and he understood great principle.
translations.idiomatic: He was firm and resolute by nature, courageous, and clear about great principle.

sentences.zh: 少舉進士，天祥開府汀州，辟充督幹架閣監軍。

translations.literal: In youth he passed the jinshi examination; when Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Ting Prefecture he was summoned as supervisory officer of the headquarters archive and military supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he passed the jinshi examination. When Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Ting Prefecture he was summoned as supervisory officer of the headquarters archive and military supervisor.

sentences.zh: 師出嶺，明哲以贛縣民義復萬安，連結諸砦拒守。

translations.literal: When the army came out of the Ling passes, Mingzhe with the militia of Gan County recovered Wan'an and linked the stockades in defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the army came out of the Ling passes, Mingzhe led the militia of Gan County to recover Wan'an and linked the stockades in defense.

sentences.zh: 兵敗，被執不屈，死於隆興。

translations.literal: His army was defeated; seized, he would not yield and died at Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: His army was defeated. Captured, he would not yield and died at Longxing.

sentences.zh: 臨刑大罵不絕口，聞者壯之。

translations.literal: At execution he reviled without cease; those who heard were inspired.
translations.idiomatic: At execution he cursed without ceasing, and those who heard were stirred.

sentences.zh: 林琦，閩人也。

translations.literal: Lin Qi was a native of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qi came from Fujian.

sentences.zh: 德祐二年，大兵既迫臨安，琦於赭山結集忠義數千人，捍禦海道。

translations.literal: In the second year of Deyou, when the great army had already pressed Lin'an, Qi at Zhe Mountain gathered several thousand loyal and righteous men to defend the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Deyou, when the main army had already pressed Lin'an, Qi gathered several thousand loyal and righteous men at Zhe Mountain to defend the sea route.

sentences.zh: 以功補宣教郎、督府主管機宜文字，充檢院。

translations.literal: For merit he was given Instructor and headquarters chief planner, and made inspector.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was appointed Instructor and headquarters chief planner, and made inspector.

sentences.zh: 文天祥開府南劍，琦佐其幕。

translations.literal: When Wen Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Qi assisted in his staff.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Qi served on his staff.

sentences.zh: 琦外文采，內忠實，數涉患難，無怨懟辭。

translations.literal: Outwardly refined in literary grace, inwardly loyal and solid, he passed through many hardships without a word of complaint.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly refined in literary grace, inwardly loyal and steadfast, he passed through many hardships without a word of complaint.

sentences.zh: 及潮州移屯，琦俱被執，至惠州遁，復執之北行，赴水，為吏所拔，至建康，以憂憤死。

translations.literal: When the headquarters moved to Chaozhou he was seized with the rest; at Huizhou he escaped, was seized again on the northward journey, threw himself into the water and was pulled out by clerks; at Jiankang he died of grief and indignation.
translations.idiomatic: When the headquarters moved to Chaozhou he was captured with the rest. At Huizhou he escaped, was captured again on the northward journey, threw himself into the water and was pulled out by guards, and at Jiankang died of grief and indignation.

sentences.zh: 蕭資，天祥幕下書史也。

translations.literal: Xiao Zi was a clerk in Tianxiang's staff.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Zi was a clerk on Tianxiang's staff.

sentences.zh: 天祥起兵，資於患難中扶持甚至。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang raised troops, Zi supported him through hardship to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang raised troops, Zi supported him through hardship to the utmost.

sentences.zh: 空坑兵敗，以全督府印功，升閣門、路鈐轄。

translations.literal: At the defeat of Kongkeng, for merit in preserving the headquarters seal intact he was promoted to Gate Guard and route commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the defeat of Kongkeng, for preserving the headquarters seal intact he was promoted to Gate Guard and route commander.

sentences.zh: 資性和厚，臨機應變，輯穆將士，總攝細務，任腹心之寄。

translations.literal: Zi's nature was gentle and thick; facing crisis he adapted; he harmonized officers and soldiers, oversaw detailed affairs, and was entrusted with inner counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Zi was gentle and steadfast by nature, adaptable in crisis, able to harmonize officers and soldiers, oversaw detailed affairs, and was entrusted with inner counsel.

sentences.zh: 潮陽移屯，與大兵遇，死之。

translations.literal: When the headquarters moved to Chaoyang, he met the great army and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the headquarters moved to Chaoyang he met the main army and died.

sentences.zh: 徐臻，溫州人。

translations.literal: Xu Zhen was a native of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhen came from Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 父官河南，德祐元年春，臻往省，以道阻。

translations.literal: His father held office in Henan; in the spring of the first year of Deyou Zhen went to visit him but was blocked on the road.
translations.idiomatic: His father held office in Henan. In the spring of the first year of Deyou Zhen went to visit him but was blocked on the road.

sentences.zh: 會天祥勤王，臻往依之，以筆劄典樞密，小心精練。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang rallied to the throne, Zhen went to join him and with documents managed the Privy Council, careful and refined.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang rallied to the throne, Zhen went to join him and managed Privy Council documents with care and refinement.

sentences.zh: 天祥被執，臻脫難復來，願從天祥北行，扶持患難，備殫忠款，至隆興病死。
