translations.literal: When Tianxiang was seized, Zhen escaped danger and came again, wishing to follow Tianxiang north, supporting him through hardship with full loyalty, until he died of illness at Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang was captured, Zhen escaped and came again, wishing to follow him north and support him through hardship with full loyalty, until he died of illness at Longxing.

sentences.zh: 金應者，性少剛知義。

translations.literal: Jin Ying was by nature somewhat stern and knew righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Ying was by nature somewhat stern and knew what righteousness demanded.

sentences.zh: 為天祥職書司，入京補承信郎，官路分。

translations.literal: He served Tianxiang in the Document Office, entered the capital and was given Chengxin Lang, and held a route post.
translations.idiomatic: He served Tianxiang in the Document Office, entered the capital and was given Chengxin Lang, and held a route post.

sentences.zh: 天祥奉使被執，左右皆散，應獨無畔誌。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang went on embassy and was seized, those around him all scattered; Ying alone had no thought of desertion.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang went on embassy and was captured, those around him all scattered, but Ying alone had no thought of desertion.

sentences.zh: 及脫走鎮江，至淮東，以憂憤死焉。

translations.literal: When they escaped from Zhenjiang and reached Huaidong, he died there of grief and indignation.
translations.idiomatic: When they escaped from Zhenjiang and reached Huaidong, he died there of grief and indignation.

sentences.zh: 何時字了翁，撫州樂安人，天祥同年進士也。

translations.literal: He Shi, styled Ziweng, was a native of Le'an in Fuzhou and a jinshi of the same year as Tianxiang.
translations.idiomatic: He Shi, whose style name was Ziweng, came from Le'an in Fuzhou and had passed the jinshi examination in the same year as Tianxiang.

sentences.zh: 調廬陵尉，尋入江西轉運司幕府，還臨江軍司理參軍。

translations.literal: He was appointed assistant magistrate of Luling, soon entered the Jiangxi transport commission staff, and returned as judicial investigator of Linjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed assistant magistrate of Luling, soon entered the Jiangxi transport commission staff, and returned as judicial investigator of Linjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 郡獄相傳，舊斬一寇，屍能行一里許。

translations.literal: In the prefectural prison there was a tradition that an old executed bandit's corpse could walk about a li or so.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefectural prison there was a tradition that the corpse of an old executed bandit could walk about a li or so.

sentences.zh: 眾神之，塐為肉身皋陶。

translations.literal: The people deified him and modeled his body in clay as the spirit of Gao Yao.
translations.idiomatic: The people deified him and modeled his body in clay as the spirit of Gao Yao.

sentences.zh: 時至，取故牘閱，此寇嘗掠殺數人，曰：「如此可為神乎？」

translations.literal: When the time came, Shi took out the old dossier to read it; this bandit had once plundered and killed several people, and said: "Can such a man be made a god?"
translations.idiomatic: When the time came, Shi took out the old dossier to read it. This bandit had once plundered and killed several people. He said, "Can such a man be made a god?"

sentences.zh: 命鞭之，湛於水，人服其明。

translations.literal: He ordered him flogged and sunk in the water; the people admired his clarity.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the image flogged and sunk in the water, and the people admired his clarity of judgment.

sentences.zh: 改知興國縣。

translations.literal: He was changed to magistrate of Xingguo County.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed magistrate of Xingguo County.

sentences.zh: 天祥起兵，辟署帥府機宜、帶行監文思院。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang raised troops he was appointed headquarters planner and honorary Director of the Wensi Court.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang raised troops he was appointed headquarters planner and honorary Director of the Wensi Court.

sentences.zh: 天祥入衛，時任留司，分司吉州。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang entered the capital on guard, Shi remained at the rear headquarters and served as deputy for Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang entered the capital on guard, Shi remained at the rear headquarters and served as deputy for Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 餉運平江，天祥奏時知撫州。

translations.literal: Supplying transport to Pingjiang, Tianxiang memorialized that Shi should be made prefect of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: While supplying transport to Pingjiang, Tianxiang memorialized that Shi should be made prefect of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 吉州下，時脫身歸鄉里。

translations.literal: When Ji Prefecture fell, Shi escaped and returned to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: When Ji Prefecture fell, Shi escaped and returned to his home district.

sentences.zh: 益王立，天祥開府南劍，時起兵趨興國接引，以時帶行卿監、江西提刑。

translations.literal: When Prince Yi was established and Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Shi raised troops and hurried to Xingguo to receive him; he was given honorary Supervisor and Jiangxi investigating commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Yi was established and Tianxiang opened his headquarters at Nanjian, Shi raised troops and hurried to Xingguo to receive him. He was given honorary Supervisor and made Jiangxi investigating commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時聚兵復崇仁縣，未幾，大軍奄至，兵敗，削髮為僧，竄跡嶺南，賣卜自給，變姓名，自號堅白道人。

translations.literal: Shi gathered troops and recovered Chongren County; before long the great army suddenly arrived, his army was defeated, he shaved his head and became a monk, hid in Lingnan, supported himself by divination, changed his name, and styled himself the Daoist of Firm Whiteness.
translations.idiomatic: Shi gathered troops and recovered Chongren County. Before long the main army suddenly arrived and his force was defeated. He shaved his head and became a monk, hid in Lingnan, supported himself by divination, changed his name, and styled himself the Daoist of Firm Whiteness.

sentences.zh: 又有陳子敬者，贛州人。

translations.literal: There was also Chen Zijing, a native of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Chen Zijing, a native of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 以貲雄鄉里，嘗從天祥遊。

translations.literal: Wealthy and dominant in his home district, he had once traveled with Tianxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wealthy and dominant in his home district, he had once traveled with Tianxiang.

sentences.zh: 天祥開閫汀州，子敬募集民兵屯皂口，據贛下流。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang opened his command at Ting Prefecture, Zijing recruited militia and encamped at Zaokou, holding the lower reaches of Gan.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang opened his command at Ting Prefecture, Zijing recruited militia and encamped at Zaokou, holding the lower reaches of Gan.

sentences.zh: 及天祥攻贛，子敬與合謀，忠效甚著。

translations.literal: When Tianxiang attacked Gan, Zijing joined in the plan and showed great loyal service.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianxiang attacked Gan, Zijing joined in the plan and showed great loyal service.

sentences.zh: 空坑兵敗，復聚兵屯黃塘砦，連結山砦不降。

translations.literal: At the defeat of Kongkeng he again gathered troops and encamped at Huangtang Stockade, linking mountain stockades without submitting.
translations.idiomatic: At the defeat of Kongkeng he again gathered troops and encamped at Huangtang Stockade, linking mountain stockades that refused to submit.

sentences.zh: 大軍以重兵襲其砦，砦潰，子敬不知所終。

translations.literal: The great army attacked the stockade with heavy force; the stockade collapsed and Zijing's end was unknown.
translations.idiomatic: The main army attacked the stockade with heavy force. The stockade collapsed and Zijing's end was unknown.

sentences.zh: 劉士昭，太和人，嘗為針工。

translations.literal: Liu Shizhao of Taihe had once been a needle-worker.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shizhao of Taihe had once been a needle-worker.

sentences.zh: 與鄉人同謀復太和縣，敗，血指書帛云：「生為宋民，死為宋鬼，赤心報國，一死而已。」

translations.literal: With fellow townsmen he plotted to recover Taihe County; defeated, he wrote in blood on silk: "Born a Song subject, dead a Song ghost, a loyal heart for the state, death alone is all."
translations.idiomatic: With fellow townsmen he plotted to recover Taihe County. When defeated, he wrote in blood on silk, "Born a Song subject, dead a Song ghost, a loyal heart for the state, death alone is all."

sentences.zh: 因以其帛自縊死。

translations.literal: He then hanged himself with that silk.
translations.idiomatic: He then hanged himself with that silk.

sentences.zh: 其黨入獄，多乞憐苟免。

translations.literal: His companions were imprisoned; many begged pity to escape.
translations.idiomatic: His companions were imprisoned, and many begged for pity to escape punishment.

sentences.zh: 有王士敏者，獨慷慨不撓，題其裾：「此生無復望生還，一死都歸談笑間，大地盡為腥血汙，好收吾骨首陽山。」

translations.literal: There was one Wang Shimin who alone was bold and unyielding; he wrote on his robe: "This life no longer hopes to return alive; one death all returns to jest and talk; the great earth all stained with bloody filth; well gather my bones at Shouyang Mountain."
translations.idiomatic: There was one Wang Shimin who alone was bold and unyielding. He wrote on his robe, "This life no longer hopes to return alive; one death all returns to jest and talk; the great earth all stained with bloody filth; well gather my bones at Shouyang Mountain."

sentences.zh: 臨刑歎曰：「恨吾病失聲，不能大罵耳。」

translations.literal: At execution he sighed: "I regret that my illness has lost my voice and I cannot revile them loudly."
translations.idiomatic: At execution he sighed, "I regret that my illness has robbed me of my voice so I cannot curse them loudly."

sentences.zh: 同時有趙孟壘者，合州人。

translations.literal: At the same time there was Zhao Menglei, a native of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time there was Zhao Menglei, a native of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 登開慶元年第，為金華尉。

translations.literal: He passed the examination in the first year of Kaiqing and served as assistant magistrate of Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the examination in the first year of Kaiqing and served as assistant magistrate of Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 臨安降，與從子由鑒懷太皇太后帛書詣益王，擢宗正寺簿、監軍。

translations.literal: When Lin'an surrendered, he and his nephew Youjian carried the Grand Empress Dowager's silk letter to Prince Yi and was promoted to registrar of the Clan Temple and military supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin'an surrendered, he and his nephew Youjian carried the Grand Empress Dowager's silk letter to Prince Yi and was promoted to registrar of the Clan Temple and military supervisor.

sentences.zh: 復明州，戰敗見獲，不屈磔死。

translations.literal: He recovered Ming Prefecture, was defeated in battle, seized, and dismembered alive without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Ming Prefecture, was defeated in battle, captured, and dismembered alive without yielding.

sentences.zh: 方大軍駐紹興，福王與芮從子曰孟松，謀舉兵，事泄，被執至臨安。

translations.literal: When the great army was stationed at Shaoxing, Prince Fu and his clansman Mengsong plotted to raise troops; the affair leaked and they were seized and taken to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army was stationed at Shaoxing, Prince Fu and his clansman Mengsong plotted to raise troops. The affair leaked and they were seized and taken to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 範文虎詰其謀逆，孟松詬曰：「賊臣負國厚恩，共危社稷，我帝室之胄，欲一刷宗廟之恥，乃更以為逆乎？」

translations.literal: Fan Wenhui interrogated them for treason; Mengsong reviled him: "Traitor ministers betrayed the state's deep favor and together endangered the altars; I am of the imperial house and wished only to wipe away the shame of the ancestral temples—yet you call this treason?"
translations.idiomatic: Fan Wenhui interrogated them for treason. Mengsong reviled him, "Traitor ministers betrayed the state's deep favor and together endangered the altars. I am of the imperial house and wished only to wipe away the shame of the ancestral temples—yet you call this treason?"

sentences.zh: 文虎怒，驅出斬之，過宋廟，呼曰：「太祖、太宗列聖之靈在天，何以使孟松至此？」

translations.literal: Wenhui in anger had him driven out and executed; passing the Song temple he cried: "The spirits of Taizu, Taizong, and the successive sages in Heaven—how could they let Mengsong come to this?"
translations.idiomatic: Wenhui in anger had him driven out and executed. Passing the Song temple he cried, "The spirits of Taizu, Taizong, and the successive sages in Heaven—how could they let Mengsong come to this?"

sentences.zh: 都人莫不隕淚。

translations.literal: The people of the capital all shed tears.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital all shed tears.

sentences.zh: 既死，雷電晝晦者久之。

translations.literal: After his death, thunder and lightning darkened the day for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: After his death, thunder and lightning darkened the day for a long time.
